Slop Tables · In development

Spreadsheet editor

Excel and Google Sheets, rebuilt for the browser.

Open now

Slop Tables has these main features: 400+ formulas, charts & pivots; Opens & saves XLSX, ODS and CSV. It opens Excel (.xlsx), OpenDocument spreadsheet (.ods), CSV, TSV.

In development: some features listed below may not be finished yet.
